REJECT
The new helper is passed `lines[i]`, but the original code read `line` (the string `PasswordNameToken.Matches(line)` was matched against, so `name.Index` refers to it), and nothing in the diff shows these are the same string, so the behaviour may have changed; the fix is to pass `line`. (The complexity reduction and the rest of the extraction look correct, but I couldn't see the method header or build the project to confirm.)
